hoenn_birch_intro: Professor Birch: Quick! My bag! There are Poke Balls in it!
Professor Birch: Pick one, any one, and help me out here!
hoenn_birch_starter: Professor Birch: Good choice! Now chase that Poochyena off!
hoenn_may_brendan_rival: Rival: Hey! Let's see who's the better trainer!
I'll be waiting for you at the next gym!
hoenn_norman_intro: Norman: Welcome to the Petalburg Gym! I'm your father... and the Normal-type Gym Leader!
hoenn_roxanne_intro: Roxanne: Welcome to Rustboro City Gym! I'm Roxanne, the Rock-type Gym Leader.
hoenn_team_magma_aqua_intro: {team} Grunt: The boss is planning something big at Mt. Chimney!
hoenn_steven_stone_gift: Steven: Here, take this Steel Wing. It will help you in battle.
hoenn_wallace_intro: Wallace: Thank you for saving Sootopolis. Now, shall we have our Gym battle?
hoenn_elite_four: Congratulations! You've reached the Pokémon League!
hoenn_newgame_intro: The moving truck rumbles to a stop in Littleroot Town.
Mom: Here we are, {player_name}! Our new home in the Hoenn region!
Mom: Professor Birch lives just next door. Why don't you go say hello?
hoenn_mom_newstart_1: Mom: The movers finally left! Most of the boxes are still packed, though.
Mom: Your father's Gym is in Petalburg City. He'd love to see how you're doing!
hoenn_mom_newstart_2: Mom: Littleroot is so peaceful. I can hear Wingull out by the shore.
Mom: Remember, if you win prize money, I'll keep it safe for you. Every Poké Dollar counts!
hoenn_mom_newstart_3: Mom: I put a little savings jar on the counter for your battle winnings.
Mom: If it ever fills up, maybe we'll buy a vacation house somewhere. Ha ha!
hoenn_mom_home_1: Mom: {player_name}! Welcome to our new Littleroot home!
Mom: The prize money you sent from your last League paid for the moving truck AND the house.
Mom: The neighbors think I won the lottery. I told them my kid is just really good at math.
hoenn_mom_home_2: Mom: I've been learning to cook Hoenn style. Today it's Lava Cookies from Lavaridge!
Mom: Owning a house in every region you conquer is turning into quite the hobby.
hoenn_mom_home_3: Mom: The weather here changes so fast! Sunny one minute, pouring rain the next.
Mom: Professor Birch says it has to do with two ancient Pokémon. Isn't that exciting?
hoenn_birch_lab: The lab is quiet. An aide looks up from her notes.
Aide: The Professor? He's out doing fieldwork on Route 101 again.
Aide: He says the best research happens in the tall grass, not behind a desk!
hoenn_rival_intro: {rival_name}: So you're the new kid who moved in next door!
{rival_name}: My dad is Professor Birch. Let's see what your Pokémon can do!
hoenn_rival_won: {rival_name}: Wow, you're good! No wonder Dad trusted you with a Pokemon.
{rival_name}: Let's head back to the lab. Dad will want to hear about this!
hoenn_rival_lost: {rival_name}: Ha! Practice your math and try again!
hoenn_devon_parts_stolen: A Devon researcher runs up to you, out of breath.
Researcher: A {team} grunt stole our Devon Parts!
Researcher: He ran east toward Rusturf Tunnel on Route 116. Please get them back!
hoenn_rusturf_won: The grunt gave back the Devon Parts... and Mr. Briney's Wingull, Peeko!
Peeko flew happily home to Mr. Briney. Take the Devon Parts back to Rustboro!
hoenn_woods_won: Grunt: Fine, keep your stupid papers!
Devon Researcher: Thank you! They wanted the papers for our new parts.
Devon Researcher: Please take this Exp. Share. It shares battle experience with your team!
hoenn_museum_stern: Dock: Captain Stern went to the Oceanic Museum to look at an exhibit.
Dock: Could you bring him the Devon Parts there?

won: The Black Fog is too proud to ever be caught.
It Self-Destructs in a burst of black mist... and is gone.
But a cold whisper lingers: it will rise again in another haunted place.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Birch's Rescue
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Someone is calling for help on Route 101, north of Littleroot Town! Go and see.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Birch's Thanks
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Birch wants to thank you at his lab in Littleroot Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Rival Showdown
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Birch's kid, {rival_name}, is on Route 103, north of Oldale Town. Go and say hello!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Pokédex
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head back to Birch's lab in Littleroot Town. He has something for you after that battle!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Visit Dad
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Your dad, Norman, is the Gym Leader of Petalburg City, west past Route 102. Go and see him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Stone Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head through Petalburg Woods to Rustboro City and defeat Roxanne at the Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Knuckle Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Deliver Steven's letter in Granite Cave and defeat Brawly in Dewford Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Oceanic Museum
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: {team} is causing trouble at the Oceanic Museum in Slateport City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Dynamo Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Wattson at the Mauville City Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mt. Chimney
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: {leader} wants the Meteorite to awaken {legend}. Stop {team} at the top of Mt. Chimney!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Heat Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Flannery at the Lavaridge Town Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Balance Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Go home to Petalburg City and battle your dad, Norman.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mega Evolution
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Steven is waiting on Route 118. He has something to show you on Southern Island.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Feather Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Winona at the Fortree City Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Steven's Mega Stone
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Steven is on Route 120 with a Mega Stone for your starter.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mt. Pyre
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: {team} is climbing Mt. Pyre to steal the {orb}!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mind Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Tate & Liza at the Mossdeep City Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Space Center
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: {team} is attacking the Mossdeep Space Center!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Primal {legend}
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Primal {legend} is in the Cave of Origin and its weather is engulfing Hoenn. Calm it!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Rain Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Wallace is back at the Sootopolis City Gym. Win your eighth badge!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Wally is waiting in Victory Road with his Mega Gallade.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Hoenn Champion
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat the Elite Four and Champion Steven at Ever Grande City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A meteoroid is heading for Hoenn! Find Zinnia at the Sky Pillar.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mega Rayquaza
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Call Rayquaza at the top of the Sky Pillar.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Into Space
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Ride Rayquaza into space and face what's inside the meteoroid.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Other Orb
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: {other_legend} stirs in the Cave of Origin. Bring the {other_orb}!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Rusturf Tunnel Rescue
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Help Mr. Briney rescue the kidnapped Wingull in Rusturf Tunnel and clear the path.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Steven's Gifts
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Meet Steven Stone multiple times and receive the Steel Wing and other rare items.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Abandoned Ship Mystery
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Explore the haunted Abandoned Ship on Route 108 and find the Scanner.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Shoal Cave Treasures
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Collect Shoal Salt and Shoal Shells in Shoal Cave for the old man in Pacifidlog Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Safari Zone Adventure
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Catch rare Pokémon in the Hoenn Safari Zone near Lilycove City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Regi Trio Awakening
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Solve the braille puzzles and awaken Regirock, Regice, and Registeel.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Contest Master
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Win Master Rank in all five contest categories and fill the Lilycove Museum with paintings.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Master of the Skies
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With Primal {legend} calmed, visit the Weather Institute on Route 119. The Director has a gift for you.
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.reward: Weather Dial + one of each weather rock
